records.synonyms_note: Mimosa quadrivalvis var. platycarpa (A.Gray) Barneby is a heterotypic synonym in current POWO; ITIS also recognizes M. roemeriana at species rank. WCVP 2021 formerly cited the concept at variety rank, but current POWO/FNA accepts species.
records.concept_caution: Do not equate all historical Mimosa quadrivalvis records with M. roemeriana; other varieties represent distinct concepts. Preserve existing canonical and source observation identity.
records.handoff: Name-only audit; no new card, range decision, or media change.
